tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: Use when you need a material id: the presets the 3D logo editor renders (chrome, gold, glass, holographic, neon, clay, wood...), each with its category and whether it needs Pro. Ids are exact strings for build_logo_editor_link, create_text_logo_project and update_project. Do not use to show the user

tools.name: list_coin_looks
tools.description: Use before build_coin_studio_link or a coin restyle: the preset looks (gold, chrome, silver, bronze), blank edges (reeded, milled, smooth), motions, lighting rooms and fonts the coin studio accepts. Read-only, no account needed.

tools.name: build_logo_editor_link
tools.description: Returns a link that opens the 3D logo editor already styled, from a wordmark (text), from a stored logo image (mark, see upload_logo_image), or on the upload panel (upload=true) when the person will drop the file themselves. Works without an account. Use list_materials for material ids.

tools.name: build_coin_studio_link
tools.description: Returns a link that opens the 3D coin studio with a mark struck into a coin. Looks: gold, chrome, silver, bronze. Works without an account.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Use when the user asks what is free, what Pro or Ultra add, or what a Generate run costs in credits: the plan features (exports, watermark, credits, saves) and the one-time credit packs, with what packs do and do not unlock. Read-only. Do not use to check the connected user's own plan; get_account d

tools.name: browse_looks
tools.description: Use when the user wants to see what is possible or pick a style before designing: the example looks (chrome, gold, glass, holographic, brushed metal, gradient, 3D text, animated), each with a rendered example image, what it is best for, the presets behind it, and an editor link that applies it. Work

tools.name: upload_logo_image
tools.description: Stores a logo image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP up to 8 MB; SVG up to 1 MB) so the 3D logo editor can extrude it, and returns a mark id plus an editor link already styled. Give exactly one source: image (a file the user attached in chat), image_url (a public https link to the image file itself, not a page

tools.name: request_logo_image_upload
tools.description: For a logo file on the user's machine that cannot be sent inside a tool call: returns a mark id and a one-shot HTTPS PUT URL. Upload the raw file bytes to it (for example `curl -T logo.png "<uploadUrl>"`), then call build_logo_editor_link with the mark id (or create_image_logo_project when signed in

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Use to know what the connected account can do before acting: plan, remaining Generate credits (period and purchased), project and share-link counts against their caps, and export limits. Read-only.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: The user's saved logos, coins and generated meshes, newest first. Optional title search and kind filter.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Details and links for one saved project by id: where it opens, its public page if published, the GLB for meshes, and with include_config the saved workspace settings (material, lighting, motion). For a picture of it, call get_project_preview.

tools.name: create_text_logo_project
tools.description: Saves a new 3D logo project from a wordmark with a material and lighting, so it appears in the user's Projects and opens in the editor. Does not spend credits.

tools.name: create_image_logo_project
tools.description: Saves a new 3D logo project from a mark stored with upload_logo_image or request_logo_image_upload, with a material and lighting, so it appears in the user's Projects. The image is traced into 3D the first time the project opens; open it once and save before publishing. Does not spend credits.

tools.name: create_invite_link
tools.description: A link that lets a signed-in person join the project as an editor or viewer (up to 50 uses, 7 days). Owner only.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently deletes a saved project, its share page and invites. Confirm with the user first. Owner only.

tools.name: quote_generation
tools.description: Use before generate_3d_model so the user knows the cost: the credits a text or image run charges at a density. Read-only, spends nothing.

tools.name: generate_3d_model
tools.description: Starts an AI generate from a text prompt or a public image URL. Spends the user's credits (see quote_generation). Returns a run id to poll with get_generation_status.

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.description: Status of a run started by generate_3d_model (or from the user's history). When completed, save it with save_generation_as_project.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: Use to find an earlier Generate run (to check, preview or save it): the recent runs with status, prompt and whether a render exists, newest first. Read-only.

tools.name: save_generation_as_project
tools.description: Keeps a completed run in Projects (idempotent per run). With public=true it is also published, which gives a share page and a public GLB URL the user can download.

tools.name: get_project_preview
tools.description: Use when the user wants to see a saved project, or you need to describe it: returns a signed URL of the studio's last saved render, valid for an hour, and the PNG inline when include_image_data is true (only on hosts that display image content; elsewhere it costs many tokens for nothing). Nothing to

tools.name: get_generation_preview
tools.description: Use once get_generation_status reports completed with hasPreview true: returns a signed URL of the provider's render of the mesh, valid for an hour, and the image inline when include_image_data is true (only on hosts that display image content). Do not use for saved logo or coin projects; get_projec

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Use when the user wants to send a saved design to someone, post it, or embed it on a site: returns the share page, the iframe embed snippet, the oEmbed endpoint and a poster image URL. Unlisted (default) works for anyone holding the link without making the project public; public makes the page index

tools.name: list_share_links
tools.description: The account's active share links, or one project's when id is given, each with page, embed and poster URLs and a view count.

tools.name: revoke_share_link
tools.description: Turns a share link off by token: the page, the embed and the poster stop serving within minutes. Cannot be undone; create_share_link makes a fresh one. Owner only.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Use when the user wants an existing project changed without opening the studio: its title, whether it is public (a public project has a share page and, for meshes, a public GLB URL), and on logo and coin projects the style: material, lighting room, background, motion, depth, font, the wordmark on te

tools.name: duplicate_project
tools.description: Use when the user wants a variant without touching the original ("a gold version of this one"): copies a saved logo or coin project with its artwork, optionally under a new title; restyle the copy with update_project. Counts against the project cap. Does not spend credits.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the user's saved projects by title and returns ids with links (the ChatGPT search contract). Use fetch for the detail of one result; list_projects for browsing with filters.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full detail for one project id returned by search (the ChatGPT fetch contract): a text summary, the opening URL and metadata.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_project_preview, get_generation_preview, list_share_links, fetch · Private data: build_logo_editor_link, upload_logo_image, request_logo_image_upload, get_project_preview, revoke_share_link, update_project · Public sink: build_logo_editor_link, upload_logo_image, request_logo_image_upload, get_account, delete_project, save_generation_as_project, create_share_link, list_share_links, revoke_share_link, update_project · Destructive: build_logo_editor_link, get_plans, delete_project, quote_generation, generate_3d_model, get_generation_status, list_generations, save_generation_as_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_project_preview, get_generation_preview, list_share_links, fetch · Private data: build_logo_editor_link, upload_logo_image, request_logo_image_upload, get_project_preview, revoke_share_link, update_project · Public sink: build_logo_editor_link, upload_logo_image, request_logo_image_upload, get_account, delete_project, save_generation_as_project, create_share_link, list_share_links, revoke_share_link, update_project · Destructive: build_logo_editor_link, get_plans, delete_project, quote_generation, generate_3d_model, get_generation_status, list_generations, save_generation_as_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
